SA-72
SUSPENSION AND AXLE - REAR LOWER SUSPENSION ARM
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE REAR WHEEL
Torque: 103 N.m (1,050 kgf.cm, 76 ft,lbf)
2. REMOVE ABS SPEED SENSOR WIRE HARNESS
CLAMP
Remove the bolt and disconnect the ABS speed sensor wire
harness clamp.
Torque: 19 N-m (194 kgf.cm, 14 ft,lbf)
3. REMOVE TAILPIPE
Remove the 2 bolts, springs, gasket, 3 0-rings and tailpipe.
Torque: 43 N.m (440 kgf-cm, 32 ft•lbf)
4. DISCONNECT PARKING BRAKE CABLE CLAMP
Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the parking brake cable
clamps.
Torque: 5.4 N-m (55 kgt•cm, 48 in.-lbt)
5. LOOSEN 3 BOLTS ON FRONT SIDE OF LOWER SUSM
PENSION ARM
Torque: 65 N•m (663 kgf ,cm, 48 ft-lbf)
HINT:
N Do not remove the bolts.
At the time of installation, after stabillz:ing the suspension,
torque the bolts.
6. DISCONNECT REAR AXLE CARRIER FROM LOWER
SUSPENSION ARM
(a} Remove the front side bolt and nut.
Torque: 74 N-m (755 kgf.cm, 55 ft-lbf)
HINT:
At the time of installation, after stabilizing the suspension,
torque the nut.
(b} Place matchmarks on both the cam plate and lower sus­
pension arm.
